name: Mirra Andreeva
intro: Mirra Andreeva is only 19. She already won a Grand Slam, one of the four biggest tournaments. She grew up in Siberia, where winters are freezing cold.
story: Mirra started tennis at six. Her big sister Erika plays pro tennis too. At 17 she won two huge tournaments in a row. In 2026 she won the French Open. She is the youngest French Open champ in more than 30 years.

funFacts.text: Her big sister Erika is a pro too. They have played each other!
She once thanked herself in a trophy speech. The crowd laughed and loved it.
She speaks Russian and English. She is learning French and Spanish.
She is a huge fan of Andy Murray. She was too shy to talk to him!
She won an Olympic silver medal in doubles in Paris in 2024.
She picked tennis because of her mom, who loved watching it on TV.
At 17 she was the youngest ever to win one of the tour's biggest events.

watchFor: Watch her favorite shot, a backhand hit right down the line.

notes: Birth date, Krasnoyarsk (Siberia), 175 cm, plays, started at six, sister Erika, 2025 Dubai + Indian Wells at 17, 2026 French Open (youngest since Seles 1992), coach Conchita Martinez, Paris 2024 doubles silver, ranking 5 confirmed via Wikipedia.
